## Episode Thesis

This episode is a macro discussion about the oil market with an energy expert. Oil trades near USD 90, driven by supply constraints, Russian refinery disruptions from Ukrainian strikes, and shifting Chinese import demand, with global inventories drawing ~5 million barrels/day; the expert argues prices are not alarming but warns critical inventory levels could arrive by year-end if the supply-demand gap persists. No individual companies or equities are discussed.
